Explore Ghora Katora, Rajgir — a beautiful and peaceful destination surrounded by hills and natural scenery in Bihar.
Located near Rajgir in Bihar, Ghora Katora is an interesting destination for travelers looking to experience the natural beauty and offbeat attractions of the region.
In this video, we take you on a virtual tour of Ghora Katora, showcasing its scenic surroundings, hills, water, natural landscapes, and the peaceful atmosphere of this unique destination.
